record.paper_title: Open Problems for Entire Functions of Bounded Index in Direction
record.original_question: For entire functions on C^n and a positive continuous function L, what is the smallest or least set A of directions with the following property: whenever an entire function F has bounded L-index in every direction b in A, it follows that F has bounded L-index in every nonzero direction b in C^n?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 2$ and let $L : \mathbb{C}^n \to (0,\infty)$ be a positive continuous function. For an entire function $F : \mathbb{C}^n \to \mathbb{C}$ and a nonzero direction $\mathbf{b} \in \mathbb{C}^n \setminus \{0\}$, the function $F$ is said to have bounded $L$-index in the direction $\mathbf{b}$ if there exists a nonnegative integer $m_0$ such that, for every $z \in \mathbb{C}^n$,
$$\frac{|\partial^k_{\mathbf{b}} F(z)|}{k!\, L(z)^k} \leq \max_{0 \leq j \leq m_0} \frac{|\partial^j_{\mathbf{b}} F(z)|}{j!\, L(z)^j} \qquad \text{for all } k \in \mathbb{N}_0,$$
where $\partial_{\mathbf{b}} F(z) = \sum_{i=1}^n b_i \frac{\partial F}{\partial z_i}(z)$ is the directional derivative and $\partial^k_{\mathbf{b}}$ denotes its $k$-th iterate. The least such $m_0$ is called the $L$-index of $F$ in the direction $\mathbf{b}$.

Determine the smallest (in the sense of inclusion, or of minimal cardinality) subset $A \subseteq \mathbb{C}^n \setminus \{0\}$ with the following property: for every entire function $F : \mathbb{C}^n \to \mathbb{C}$, if $F$ has bounded $L$-index in every direction $\mathbf{b} \in A$, then $F$ has bounded $L$-index in every nonzero direction $\mathbf{b} \in \mathbb{C}^n \setminus \{0\}$.
artifact.category_tag: Entire functions of bounded L-index in direction
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of identifying a minimal set of testing directions that forces boundedness of $L$-index in all directions is listed among the open problems in the theory of entire functions of bounded $L$-index in direction. Recent literature (Bandura, Skaskiv, and collaborators) develops sufficient conditions and partial results in particular cases (e.g., for functions with separated variables or for composition with slice entire functions) but does not provide a complete characterization of the minimal set $A$. No source found indicating the general problem has been resolved.

status_evidence.title: Slice Holomorphic Functions in Several Variables with Bounded L-Index in Direction
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses ongoing problems related to bounded L-index in direction for several complex variables, without resolving the question of a minimal testing set of directions.
status_evidence.claim: Active research area; the minimal-set problem is not resolved in this work.

status_evidence.title: Entire functions of bounded index in frame
status_evidence.snippet: Studies bounded index conditions across frames/sets of directions, providing partial sufficient conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for specific configurations of direction sets.
